searchText: `SHARD_BLOCK_OFFSETS` starts from `1` which results in attester is not being able to crosslink a shard block proposed in _current_ slot. Is this by design? yes, beacon blocks are created at the start of a slot, shard blocks are created partway through a slot. That shard block can then optimally be crosslinked at the start of the next slot beacon block -> shard block (refs beacon) -> attestations (including vote for shard block) - > | NEW SLOT | -> beacon block (include attestations from prev slot) so an attester assigned to slot `S` _votes_ on a shard block from slot `S`. This can be included in the beacon block at slot `S + 1`
